title: Gymnopedie No. 1
subtitle: cross-checked against the Mutopia Project edition
trains: A wide-spanning left hand alternating a low bass note with a chord high above it (up to a two-and-a-half-octave leap), sustained pedal colour, ties held across barlines and soft, patient dynamic shading (pp/p/mp/f) at a slow tempo.

provenance.author: Musicanyya practice material
provenance.basedOn: Satie, Trois Gymnopedies, No. 1 (public domain, composed 1888). Key (2 sharps), tempo marking (Lent et douloureux, quarter = 50), metre (3/4), the alternating low-bass/high-chord left-hand accompaniment pattern and the right-hand melody's entrance in measure 5 were checked against the Mutopia Project's public-domain LilyPond edition (piece-info id 37, gymnopedie_1, typeset by Evin Robertson from the Dover Edition).
provenance.note: The left-hand voicing - a low bass note answered by a chord roughly two octaves higher - is authentic to the source, not a simplification; it is why this piece computes to Advanced (criteria 16 and 17) rather than the Intermediate shelf it was first drafted for.
